description: This JavaScript module provides utility functions for calculating week-based date computations, including determining the week number and day of year from calendar dates, and vice versa. It handles ISO week date calculations and accounts for edge cases across year boundaries.

methods.name: firstWeekOffset(year, dow, doy)
methods.description: Computes the offset for the first week of the year based on the year, day of week, and day of year parameters.

methods.name: dayOfYearFromWeeks(year, week, weekday, dow, doy)
methods.description: Calculates the year and day of year corresponding to a specific week number and weekday, considering the first week of the year.

methods.name: weekOfYear(mom, dow, doy)
methods.description: Determines the week number and year for a given date object, based on the week configurations.

methods.name: weeksInYear(year, dow, doy)
methods.description: Calculates the total number of weeks in a given year, accounting for the starting offset and the following year's offset.
